items.title: Stop feeding ad-trackers your data — uBlock Origin blocks ads and trackers free inside Firefox
items.summary: Install uBlock Origin for free from `addons.mozilla.org` — open Firefox, press `Ctrl+Shift+A` to reach Add-ons, search "uBlock Origin," and click Add. Out of the box it blocks ads, cross-site trackers, and coin-miner scripts with almost no memory cost.

items.title: Find out if your email is already in a data breach — Have I Been Pwned checks it free in 10 seconds
items.summary: Go to Have I Been Pwned at `haveibeenpwned.com`, type your email address, and hit "pwned?" — it checks your address against billions of breached accounts and tells you exactly which breaches exposed it. No signup, no cost.

items.title: Run private AI on your own PC — LM Studio is the free desktop app that keeps your chats off the cloud
items.summary: Download LM Studio free from `lmstudio.ai`, install it, pick a model like Llama or Qwen from its built-in catalog, and start chatting — everything runs on your machine. No account, nothing leaves your PC.

items.title: Your PC says it can't run Windows 11? WhyNotWin11 tells you exactly which requirement fails — free
items.summary: Download WhyNotWin11 free from `github.com/rcmaehl/WhyNotWin11`, run the `.exe`, and it lists each Windows 11 requirement — TPM 2.0, Secure Boot, RAM, CPU, storage — as pass or fail, so you know what's actually blocking you.

items.title: Your fan is screaming or your PC keeps crashing? HWiNFO shows the real temperatures, voltages and fan speeds for free
items.summary: Download HWiNFO free from `hwinfo.com`, run it and choose "Sensors-only," and you'll see live temperatures, fan RPM, and voltages for every part — so you fix the actual failing component instead of guessing.
